markets.summary: Wall Street had another volatile session on Wednesday: AI fears pushed the Nasdaq sharply lower in early trading before an afternoon bounce in Oracle, CoreWeave and other tech names limited the damage, leaving the Nasdaq down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.25%. Asian stocks steadied on Thursday, with Korea's Kospi leading gains, while US markets are closed today for Thanksgiving.

stories.headline: AI sell-off deepens before an afternoon rebound limits losses
stories.summary: US tech stocks fell hard early on Wednesday as fears over the sustainability of the AI boom intensified, leaving the Nasdaq 100 on the brink of a bear market before Oracle, CoreWeave and others recovered. Asian markets stabilised overnight, and software shares have held up better than chipmakers as investors rethink who wins from AI.
